candidates.angle: Arjuna's delusion is destroyed by Krishna's grace
Arjuna stands free of doubt and ready to act
candidates.evidence: स्थितोऽस्मि गतसन्देहः करिष्ये वचनं तव (I am standing, without doubt, I will do your word)

en.intro: In the final verse of the Gita, Arjuna answers Krishna. What has changed inside him? Listen for the word that tells you.
en.notice: Arjuna names one thing he has received, smriti, memory. Krishna's teaching has brought it back, and with it the confusion that clouded his sight.
en.next: Sanjaya closes the Gita by calling this dialogue wondrous and hair-raising.
en.meaning: Arjuna says: By your grace, O Achyuta, my delusion is destroyed and memory restored. I stand free of doubt and will do what you say.

hi.intro: गीता के अंतिम श्लोक में अर्जुन कृष्ण को उत्तर देते हैं। उनके भीतर क्या बदला है? उस शब्द को सुनिए जो आपको बताएगा।
hi.meaning: अर्जुन कहते हैं, हे अच्युत, आपकी कृपा से मेरा मोह नष्ट हो गया है और स्मृति प्राप्त हो गयी है। मैं सन्देहरहित होकर स्थित हूँ और आपकी आज्ञा का पालन करूँगा।
hi.notice: अर्जुन एक चीज़ का नाम लेते हैं, स्मृति, यानी स्मृति। कृष्ण के उपदेश से यह वापस आ गई है, और उसके साथ वह मोह भी चला गया जो उनकी दृष्टि को धुंधला कर रहा था।
hi.next: संजय इस संवाद को अद्भुत और रोमांचक कहते हुए गीता का समापन करते हैं।

en.intro: In the final verse of the Gita, Arjuna answers Krishna. What has changed inside him? Listen for the word that tells you.
en.body: Arjuna says: By your grace, O Achyuta, my delusion is destroyed and memory restored. I stand free of doubt and will do what you say. Arjuna names one thing he has received, smriti, memory. Krishna's teaching has brought it back, and with it the confusion that clouded his sight. Sanjaya closes the Gita by calling this dialogue wondrous and hair-raising.
